list.label: Market
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT market
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total unit cost (exchange + registration) by application month
panels.description: Per-contract fee (exchange fee + registration fee, in BRL) from the monthly B3 Fee Unit Cost report (BVBG.043.01, `b3_fee_unit_cost` parquet), plotted at each publication's start-of-validity date as a step line. One series per fee line (asset, market, day-trade flag, trade type, strategy leg). Filtered by the Asset, Market and Day trade variables and the time range (on the validity start date).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  concat_ws(' · ', asset, 'mkt ' || market, CASE WHEN day_trade THEN 'day trade' END, CASE WHEN trade_type <> '0' THEN 'tx ' || trade_type END, CASE WHEN strategy_leg IS NOT NULL THEN 'leg ' || strategy_leg END) AS series,
  (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
  AND ('__all' IN ($day_trade) OR day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade))
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Current unit costs (latest publication in range)
panels.description: All fee lines from the most recent Fee Unit Cost report whose validity start falls in the time range: exchange, registration and total fee per contract (BRL), plus rollover fees and their date window, and the validity period. Filtered by the Asset, Market and Day trade variables. The latest report is picked before the variable filters, so the table is empty if that report has no rows matching them.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT asset, market, segment, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg,
  exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee,
  registration_fee::DOUBLE AS registration_fee,
  (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee,
  rollover_from, rollover_to,
  rollover_exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS rollover_exchange_fee,
  rollover_registration_fee::DOUBLE AS rollover_registration_fee,
  valid_from, valid_to
FROM d
WHERE rpt_dt = (SELECT max(rpt_dt) FROM d)
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
  AND ('__all' IN ($day_trade) OR day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade))
ORDER BY asset, market, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg

panels.title: Unit cost changes vs previous publication
panels.description: Fee lines whose total fee per contract (exchange + registration, BRL) changed compared with the previous monthly publication of the same line (same segment, market, asset, day-trade flag, trade type and strategy leg), with the percentage change. The previous value is looked up over the full history, even before the time range. Filtered by the Asset, Market and Day trade variables and the time range; newest first, capped at 500 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    exchange_fee + registration_fee AS total_fee,
    lag(exchange_fee + registration_fee) OVER w AS prev_total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WINDOW w AS (
    PARTITION BY segment, market, asset, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg
    ORDER BY valid_from
  )
)
SELECT valid_from, asset, market, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg,
  prev_total_fee::DOUBLE AS previous_total_fee,
  total_fee::DOUBLE AS total_fee,
  (total_fee / nullif(prev_total_fee, 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS change_pct
FROM d
WHERE prev_total_fee IS NOT NULL
  AND total_fee <> prev_total_fee
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
  AND ('__all' IN ($day_trade) OR day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade))
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY valid_from DESC, abs(total_fee - prev_total_fee) DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Most expensive regular contracts (latest publication in range)
panels.description: Top 15 asset/market pairs by total fee per contract in the latest Fee Unit Cost report in the time range, with exchange and registration fees stacked (BRL). Only regular lines are included: not day trade, trade type 0, no strategy leg. Unfiltered top-N: the Asset, Market and Day trade variables do not apply.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT asset || ' (mkt ' || market || ')' AS instrument,
  exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee,
  registration_fee::DOUBLE AS registration_fee
FROM d
WHERE rpt_dt = (SELECT max(rpt_dt) FROM d)
  AND NOT day_trade
  AND trade_type = '0'
  AND strategy_leg IS NULL
ORDER BY exchange_fee + registration_fee DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Day-trade unit cost as % of regular
panels.description: Day-trade total fee per contract divided by the regular (non-day-trade) total fee for the same publication, segment, market, asset, trade type and strategy leg, plotted at the validity start date. Lines without a matching day-trade fee are not shown. Filtered by the Asset and Market variables and the time range; the Day trade variable is not applied.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
    AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT r.valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  concat_ws(' · ', r.asset, 'mkt ' || r.market, CASE WHEN r.day_trade THEN 'day trade' END, CASE WHEN r.trade_type <> '0' THEN 'tx ' || r.trade_type END, CASE WHEN r.strategy_leg IS NOT NULL THEN 'leg ' || r.strategy_leg END) AS series,
  ((t.exchange_fee + t.registration_fee)
    / nullif(r.exchange_fee + r.registration_fee, 0))::DOUBLE AS day_trade_ratio
FROM d r
JOIN d t
  ON t.rpt_dt = r.rpt_dt
  AND t.segment = r.segment
  AND t.market = r.market
  AND t.asset = r.asset
  AND t.trade_type = r.trade_type
  AND t.strategy_leg IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.strategy_leg
  AND t.day_trade
WHERE NOT r.day_trade
ORDER BY time, series
